description: The finite Boolean truth-table test for consequence returns true exactly when the finite premise set semantically entails its conclusion.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.checkEntails_eq_true.{u} {α : Type u} [DecidableEq α]
  (Γ : Finset (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.PropFormula α))
  (A : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.PropFormula α) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.checkEntails Γ A = true ↔
    Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.Entails Γ A
